topic: What If Your Attachments Are Why You Can't Breathe Easy?

slides.text: What if your attachments are why you can't breathe easy?
Every attachment quietly speeds up your breath, and steals your peace.
You don't have to fight it. Just *notice* the feverishness, and soften.
Non-attachment to the small stuff is what makes you charming.

slides.cta: Notice where your grip is tightest today.
